scene utalovehotel12

scene utalovehotel13

scene utalovehotel14
: I mean...there is a bathtub. And it looks like there’s a shower too. The only issue is that the glass is see through and...yeah.

scene utalovehotel15
: What?! Absolutely not! I was just saying that if you want to take a bath or something, I can just close my eyes or...watch videos on my phone until you’re done.
: At least that way you wouldn’t be cold anymore.
: I feel like this is the part where I’m supposed to be a gentleman and insist that you go first but, honestly, that sounds good and I’m probably going to take you up on it.
scene utalovehotel13
: Don’t you think you might be a little too carefree sometimes, Sensei?
: That means nothing from a girl who spent her hard earned money getting the two of us a room in a love hotel.
: Make up your gosh darn mind about whose money it is already.
: Fine. It’s mine. Now, give the rest of it back or I’m going to go see if the couple next door wants to come and join us for a foursome.
: That’s a whole lot of people and not a lot of Uta.
: Don’t worry. I wouldn’t be open to sharing you anyway.
: So you can take, but you won’t give. I see how it is.
scene utalovehotel16
: I’ll tell you what...tonight’s clearly been a slog for both of us, so...
: How ‘bout you get into that bathroom...
: Take off all of your clothes...
: And let me swap places with Uta-chan one more time so she can provide a little...special service to make your night that much better...

: Well, I can’t just tell you while you still have all of your clothes on, Master.
: I really wish I could bring myself to believe that there is any hope for sexual gratification in those words, but I just really can’t at this point.
: Why not?
: Because you have broken me.
: Then I guess I’ll just have to be really gentle when I’m putting you back together, won’t I?

scene utalovehotel17
: Don’t forget to make sure all of the surfaces are properly wiped down first! This is a sketchy hotel and it would be a real shame if Uta-chan were to be sullied by another surprise fluid tonight!

scene utalovehotel18
: Oh my God...what am I doing?
: Are you sure you don’t want to just take a bath together? You-
scene utalovehotel19
: Yup!
: And I know that saying this will probably have the reverse effect, but please don’t look over here for the next thirty seconds! I have to do something really quick!
scene black
I fill the bath with water, making sure its warm before stripping down and getting inside.
I also defy all expectations and don’t look Uta’s way for the full thirty seconds I promised to abstain for.
At second thirty-one, though, you can bet your ass that’s exactly where I looked.
Unfortunately, by then, she was finished with whatever she needed to do...and so I turn my gaze back to the water as she makes her way across the room and over to me.
: So...are you ready for your special service, Master?
: Ready to be disappointed, you mean? Yes.
: Don’t get testy with me. Do you have any idea how many people would kill for what you’re about to experience?
: Up until now, I’ve only done this for my family.
: Okay, well that just means my opinion of you is going to change dramatically if this actually does wind up being sexual.
: Master, please. If it’s incest you’re looking for, you’re going to need to come back during the morning shift and ask for the one with twintails. She’ll have what you need for sure.
scene utalovehotel20
: Wow, what a surprise. Something completely G-rated.
: Oh, hush. You know you’re enjoying this.
: Besides, you should be happy since the last person I did this for died of brain cancer and you’re still alive and kicking.
: Yeah, that makes me feel great.
: On a serious note, though...just relax, Master. Let your worries wash away.
: It must be so nice finally being out of the cold, huh? Can you feel your body warming back up?
: Yeah. But it does feel a little bad knowing that you’re still soaking wet when you should be in my place right now.
scene utalovehotel21
: Yeah, uhh...
: Probably not a good idea for me to take my clothes off in here.

: Uhhhh...

scene utalovehotel22
: Can’t say this sounds like letting your troubles wash away, Master.
: Just “Sensei” is fine right now. I like being called “Master” and all, but I’d like for this to be a memory between Uta and me. Not Uta-chan and me.
scene utalovehotel23
: (Screaming internally and also horny)

scene utalovehotel24

: It’s really only my underwear and socks that bother me when they’re wet and I already took those off like a minute ago.
scene utalovehotel25
: Is that what you were doing when you made me look away?
: What’s this? You actually looked away? Who knows when the next chance you’ll get to see me in that state is, Sensei?
: I’m sure the day will come. I’m surprised you’re just...okay with talking about that, though.
: Why? Are you getting excited?
: Would you join me if I was?
: I’d have to make a phone call first.
scene utalovehotel26
: If that is what must be done, so be it. Just maybe don’t mention my age. Or my job. Or even my appearance as I don’t want your parents trying to track me down.
: I’m not telling anybody anything, Sensei. Don’t you worry.
: What matters now is enjoying our time here before the rain stops.
: This is all just one more cliche we’ll scratch into our memory books. And when we look back on it years from now, if you’re still putting up with me then, I’m sure we’ll laugh.
scene utalovehotel27
: Unless you and Io really do run away, that is. Which you shouldn’t, because losing both of you at once would make it hard for even me to keep on smiling.
: Maybe I will? I bet Io would get in the bath with me.
scene utalovehotel28
: PFFFT! HAHAHAHA! HAHAHA!
: ...Did I say something funny?
scene utalovehotel29
: Oh, no! No no no! I shouldn’t have laughed there! I’m sorry! It wasn’t funny.
: That just...it took me by surprise, that’s all. I wasn’t like...doubting you or anything.
scene utalovehotel30
: I, uhh...would like to hear why you think that, though.
: Unless it’s something you don’t want to talk about. Which, if it is, we can go back to being silent and listening to all of the other couples have sex.
scene utalovehotel31
: Oh! And when I say “other” couples, I’m not implying that we’re a couple. No way. We’re just two people stuck inside a room full of condoms, trying to keep each other comfortable without using any!
: Classic Uta-Sensei relationship, right?!
: Please talk. You’re making me feel like I made a huge mistake just now.
: I just think you’re acting a little weird, that’s all.
scene utalovehotel32
: Well...just...
: What makes you think Io would do something like that?
: You...know you can like somebody without wanting to get in their pants, right?
: But that’s the best part.
scene utalovehotel33
: Not everybody’s like that, Sensei. Some people just want somebody they can be close to or...somebody they don’t get bored of.
: I’m sure there are plenty of girls in the class, cough cough Ami, who’d be happy to jump your bones, but you’re smarter than expecting everybody to just be on board right away, aren’t you?
: Of course I am. For example, I know you’re in no rush to “jump my bones,” which is why I’m able to constantly joke about it the way I do.
: Hahah...yeah...funny jokes...
scene utalovehotel34
: I can’t accurately judge everyone, though. So if you know something I don’t know and are at liberty to share it, I implore you to do so.

scene utalovehotel35

: Uta-

scene utalovehotel37

scene utalovehotel38

scene utalovehotel39

I can not hear Uta run away, but I know that she does.
I finish bathing and hang my clothes up to dry on an old towel rack.

A maroon pair of panties, wet from the rain and lustful teen martyrdom.

And I dirty them.
Repeatedly.
